tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra yai/

'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi sgo nas tshogs mchod khri 'bum lta bu phul ba'i tshe/ snod gcig tu tshogs gtor gcig dang ril bu brgya/ tshogs rdzas ci 'byor bzhag /de 'dra tsho bcu la stong phrag gcig tu 'ong bas grangs mang po la des mtshon/ tshogs chang bdud rtsi bcas bkod pa'i snod gcig la/ chu chang nang gsum bran te/ phrin las gzhung gi tshogs rgyas pa tshar gcig btang*/ bar pa bdud rtsir byin rlabs skabs 'dir mi dgos pas bzhag la lhag ma smon lam yan btang/ de nas slar yang bdud rtsi bran te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ha hoḥhrī: zhes byin gyis brlab/ hrī: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rje btsun 'khor ba sgrol mdzad yum: rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtshor bcas: tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren gshegs: sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdza: zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: rang byung bhañdza snang ba snod: rtsa 'khor dbyings kyi ka pā lar: bza' btung srid bcud byang chub sems: rig pa rang gsal tshogs gtor bshams: phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: gsang gsum dam tshig nyams pa bshags: bdud bzhi'i bar chad dbyings su sgrol: sku gsung thugs kyi tshe dbang stsol: sa ma ya pañtsa kā ma ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: zhes mchod bshags bsgral ba phyogs 'thus su 'bul/ hrīḥphaiṃ: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bar chad kun sol tshe dpal skyed: rnam bzhi'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: zhes lhag ma bsngo/ spro na/ bde chen rdo rje'i dam tshig rdzas: tshogs kyi mchod pa bla na med: dgyes pa chen po'i longs spyod kyis: 'chi med ye shes sku 'grub shog: ces smon lam yang gdab/ de ltar tshar dgu byas/ slar rgyas pa tshar gcig dang/ bsdus pa dgu re ste/

rgyas bsdus spel bas brgya rtsa gcig grub nas/ mchod bshags bsgral ba yan song ba dang*/ rgyas pa ltar bar ba bdud rtsir byin rlabs kyi sngags bzla zhing rol la/ lhag chog rgyas par bya zhing smon lam gdab bo// 'di'ang gter chen bla ma nyid kyi spyan sngar bka' lung gi rjes gnang ji bzhin blo gros mtha' yas kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
